scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:template-sync && tsc --project tsconfig.node.json && node scripts/write-electron-package-type.cjs && VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron .
scripts.build: npm run build:template-sync && tsc --project tsconfig.node.json && node scripts/write-electron-package-type.cjs && vite build
scripts.package: npm run build:cli && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:cli && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.package:win: npm run build:cli && npm run build && node scripts/package-win.cjs
scripts.package:win:installer-test: npm run build:cli && npm run build && node scripts/package-win-installer-test.cjs
scripts.package:git-proof:mac: npm run build:cli && npm run build && node scripts/package-git-proof.cjs mac
scripts.package:git-proof:win: npm run build:cli && npm run build && node scripts/package-git-proof.cjs win
scripts.make: npm run build:cli && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:template-sync && npm run typecheck:prepared
scripts.test:migration: vitest run --maxWorkers=2 electron/migration electron/schemaDiscriminated electron/managedOperationBridge.integration.test.ts electron/managedRuntimeWriteSafety.test.ts electron/courseStartup.integration.test.ts electron/remoteCourseDiscovery.test.ts electron/courseSetupService.test.ts src/migration-review
scripts.package:mac:archive-test: npm run build:cli && npm run build && node scripts/package-mac-archive-test.cjs
